purpose: Triggers an action or event. The single mechanism for users to commit, cancel, or navigate via explicit action.

variants.name: primary
variants.usage: The single most important action on a screen. At most one per screen.

variants.name: secondary
variants.usage: Supporting actions such as Back or Cancel.

variants.name: danger
variants.usage: Destructive, hard-to-reverse actions (delete, cancel subscription). Requires a confirmation dialog.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text; also the accessible name.

accessibility.requirement: Must have a non-empty visible label that doubles as the accessible name.
Focus ring uses color.border.focus and is never suppressed.

constraints.rule: At most one primary button per screen.
Danger buttons must be guarded by a confirmation dialog.
Variant meaning may not be conveyed by color alone; labels must state the action.
